notes.convolutional-networks.md:
# Convolutional networks

Convolutional neural networks slide learned filters over an image.
Pooling layers downsample; ResNet adds skip connections so very deep stacks still train.
Used for image classification and object detection.
notes.linear-algebra.md:
# Linear algebra

Eigenvalues: det(A - lambda I) = 0. Trace = sum of eigenvalues, determinant = product.
Spectral theorem: a symmetric matrix has real eigenvalues and orthogonal eigenvectors.
Diagonalizable when there are n independent eigenvectors.

notes.context-windows.md:
# Context windows

Ollama defaulted num_ctx to 4096 on a 16GB Mac.
Once the conversation filled the window, the system prompt was evicted and tool selection broke.
Fix: set num_ctx 16384 and trim old tool results first.
notes.python-packaging.md:
# Python packaging

One virtual environment per project (.venv). Install with pip.
Pin exact versions in requirements.txt so a fresh clone gets the same set.
notes.transformers.md:
# Transformers

Self-attention lets every token weigh every other token.
Positional encodings add order information. Encoder-only models like BERT, decoder-only like GPT.
